text:
You need a way to connect your CPR, daycare, and notary businesses under one clear web presence, while also supporting outreach to schools, banks, and other local organizations.  

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I can help design a clean landing page or multi-service site structure that ties your businesses together without forcing you into three separate websites, and I can build the outreach workflow so you can track results and contact lists.  

For Juniper & Ash Home, I rebuilt a slow theme-based shop into a headless storefront and CMS; largest contentful paint improved from 4.1s to 1.3s. For Oakfield Charities, I upgraded a donor system and rebuilt data-entry screens; donation entry time dropped 45%.  

I’m professional, deadline-focused, and comfortable meeting by Zoom or phone.
